source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one independently selected, visually complex test photograph that uses the supplied adult appearance reference while making a drowned lakeside settlement and its original architectural relationships unmistakably testable in the rendered pixels.
subject: An unmistakably adult underwater archaeologist in a clear observation helmet documenting a drowned lakeside settlement whose structures remain in their original positions.
setting: Cold blue-green lake water above a silted former street, joined masonry foundations, standing lower walls, steps, and doorways on the lakebed.
event: The archaeologist records the connected in-place settlement on a waterproof survey slate while survey lights reveal the continuous street-and-foundation layout.
visual_priorities: Make the joined foundations, standing wall remnants, and street visibly continuous in one frame.
Show multiple architectural elements retaining their original ground relationships rather than appearing as scattered rubble.
Keep the reference-derived adult facial, hair, and makeup appearance observable through the clear faceplate.
Preserve legibility through sediment haze with angled caustics and controlled survey illumination.
baseline_prompt_en: A wide, low three-quarter underwater survey photograph shows an unmistakably adult underwater archaeologist in a clear observation helmet, recording a drowned lakeside street on a waterproof survey slate. Through the faceplate, the visible face has long near-black softly waved hair, warm brown eyes, softly defined brows, fine black eyeliner, and muted coral lips. A continuous drowned settlement rests in place beneath the lake. Intact building foundations remain joined to standing lower walls. A submerged street runs between the original building footprints. Doorways, steps, and masonry walls keep their original ground relationships. Undisturbed silt and algae bind the structures to the lakebed. Angled late-day caustics cut through cold blue-green sediment haze, while controlled survey lights reveal silted masonry and aligned foundations. Keep the archaeologist secondary in the near foreground and the connected architectural layout legible across the wide frame, with documentary optical realism and natural underwater falloff.
